name: Sierra Nevada Tertiary auriferous gravel cliff exposures (round 2)
description: Sites where Eocene-Miocene cemented quartz-cobble auriferous channel gravel is currently exposed as sheer, vertical, hammer-able cliff face (not slough-buried). Built from parallel research + precision georeferencing pass. Coordinates WGS84 decimal degrees. See markdown table for confidence, access, and source citations.

properties.site: Malakoff TLS Site 1 - SW alcove (USGS-measured active erosion)
properties.what_visible: N-facing alcove 120m wide x 30-50m high; 887 sq m face; three stacked sedimentary units (upper gravel + clay + lower gravel)
properties.access: From Diggins Pond trailhead, walk Diggins Loop Trail clockwise ~0.7 mi. Flat pit floor.
properties.source: USGS OFR 2019-1124 Howle et al; ScienceBase 5d1cf22de4b0941bde64ce0c; pit boundary shapefile 59ea84c9e4b0026a55fd012d

properties.site: Malakoff TLS Site 2 - W amphitheater (HIGHEST measured erosion rate)
properties.what_visible: E-facing amphitheater ~100m wide x 40m vertical; cream/tan exposed sediment; erosion rate 0.14 m3/m2/yr (most actively-stripped of the four sites)
properties.access: From Diggins Pond, follow Diggins Loop W along pit floor; Site 2 is on right (N) as trail enters W embayment.

properties.site: Malakoff TLS Site 4 Western (NE three-cliff complex)
properties.what_visible: Westernmost of 3 cliff faces in 500m NE-corner complex; S/SW-facing exposure
properties.access: From Slaughterhouse Trailhead / Chute Hill Campground, Slaughterhouse Trail ~0.4 mi to pit floor.

properties.site: Malakoff TLS Site 4 Central (NE three-cliff complex)
properties.what_visible: Central of 3 cliff faces in NE 500m complex; S/SW-facing
properties.access: Slaughterhouse Trail to pit floor; cross ~150 m E of Site 4W.

properties.site: Malakoff TLS Site 4 Eastern (NE three-cliff complex)
properties.access: Slaughterhouse Trail to pit floor; ~300 m E of Site 4W.

properties.site: Malakoff TLS Site 5 - SE twin alcoves (OFR cover photo)
properties.what_visible: N-facing twin-alcove pair, 100m wide x 40m high; central ridge separating Eastern Area 1/2 and Western Area 1/2; Optech scanner deployed atop W and E sides 105m apart (means walk-up access top AND bottom)
properties.access: From Diggins Loop E end, short cross-pit walk. Flat.
properties.source: USGS OFR 2019-1124 - this is the report's COVER PHOTO viewpoint

properties.site: Gold Run I-80 Rest Area + Stewart Mine traverse (30-sec walk-up)
properties.cliff_height_ft: 30-80 ft cuts, 200+ ft pit walls behind rest area
properties.what_visible: Cross-bedded sands and gravels of ancestral S Fk Yuba; orange/tan/white kaolinitic faces on freeway shoulder cut; larger Stewart pit walls behind the rest area pet area
properties.access: I-80 westbound rest area near MM 143, ~0.5 mi W of Gold Run exit 144. 30-second walk from pavement.
properties.source: Sierra College field-trip transect (Stop 4); Konigsmark Geologic Trips: Sierra Nevada

properties.site: I-80 Magra Rd to Monte Vista cuts (same Eocene channel)
properties.what_visible: Rusty-red to orange weathered cut faces on N side of freeway; thick layers of red Eocene river gravel
properties.access: I-80 exit 142 (Magra Rd); safest pullover is Magra Rd frontage under the overcrossing.
properties.source: Sierra College Dutch Flat/Gold Run district

properties.site: Gold Run 'The Bluffs' / Paleobotanist Trail (BLM Secret World)
properties.what_visible: Surviving mining amphitheater west of I-80; upper gravels visible as walls; petrified-wood bearing horizons in Paleobotanist Trail bench
properties.access: I-80 Magra Rd exit, S on Magra to Garrett Rd, then to BLM gate; walk Paleobotanist Trail ~0.5 mi. Verify BLM gate status before going - pedestrian only past gate.
properties.source: Russell Towle northforktrails blog; mindat Gold Run District; gambolinman 2012 field report

properties.cliff_height_ft: 100-175 ft pit walls visible across canyon
properties.what_visible: Classic Malakoff-style white/tan cliff scars in canyon below the pullout; California Historical Landmark #629 with interpretive plaque and observation deck; pullout itself on bedrock/Mehrten cap - walk short interpretive trail down to touch gravel
properties.access: Hwy 20 ~17 mi E of Nevada City; signed paved pullout, truck-sized.
properties.source: USFS Tahoe NF rec page; CHL #629; mindat Alpha-Omega

properties.site: Omega Diggings pit (foot access, off Omega Rd from Hwy 20)
properties.what_visible: 150 ft lower auriferous gravel + 6 ft clay + 20 ft upper gravel = 175 ft total section (Lindgren); two bare amphitheaters cut into ridge
properties.access: Omega Rd from Hwy 20 - Tahoe NF, not posted.
properties.source: Wikipedia Omega Hydraulic Diggings; mindat; Lindgren PP 73

properties.site: Blue Point Mine / Black Swan Preserve cliff escarpment
properties.what_visible: Hydraulic cliff escarpment wrapping E around Black Swan Pond; 200-ft cliff carved into eastern flank of placer and basalt ridgeline; peregrine falcons and cliff swallows nest here (biology proves bare vertical rock)
properties.access: Trailhead off Mooney Flat Rd, ~1/4 mi N of Hwy 20; ~10-15 min off I-80 at Smartsville. 2-mi loop, Bear Yuba Land Trust, public.
properties.source: Bear Yuba Land Trust; Excelsior Project Blue Point page; Yuba Treadhead 2019 trip report

properties.site: Mt. Vernon Mine (North Bay Resources, active Tertiary-gravel mine)
properties.what_visible: Underground mine with modern portal, tunnel, ventilation; MSHA full-scale production approval Oct 2024; ~4,200 t Tertiary gravel ore stockpiled June 2025 for Bishop Gold Mill shipment. Material: large cobble conglomerates cemented with ferruginous sand matrix - the classic Great Blue Lead facies, capped by Mehrten andesitic mudflow.
properties.access: Mountain House Rd / FS road network W of Downieville. PRIVATE active mine - permission from North Bay Resources required (310-584-7278). Directly adjacent and upstream from Ruby Mine on same channel.
properties.source: North Bay Resources press releases July/Aug 2024; northbay-resources.com/mount-vernon; USGS GNIS feature 263893
properties.note: Precise portal coords not published by operator - this is the GNIS feature centroid; confirm on the ground.

properties.site: Ruby Mine drift portal (active operation - same Great Blue Lead)
properties.what_visible: Active mine infrastructure; fresh channel face advanced regularly inside
properties.access: Sec 15 NW T19N R10E, N of Alleghany. PRIVATE - contact Underground Gold Miners Museum (530-287-3330).

properties.site: Cherokee / Spring Valley hydraulic mine (Butte Co.)
properties.what_visible: Light-colored amphitheaters on N flank of Sugar Loaf / N edge of Table Mountain visible on ESRI; 'looks very similar to Malakoff Diggins' (insuremekevin); was largest hydraulic mine in the world
properties.access: Cherokee Rd off Hwy 70 N of Oroville. PRIVATE land (Spring Valley / Diamond Match successor) - no legal walk-in; rim view from Cherokee Rd or Sugar Loaf side.
properties.source: MRDS #10310601; Western Mining History; insuremekevin field writeup
properties.note: No 2010+ in-pit photo proof; physics same as Malakoff (135 yr since closure).

properties.site: Brandy City pit NW headwall (per Round 1 verification)
properties.cliff_height_ft: 50-60 ft DEM-confirmed, possibly 300 ft per 2013 eyewitness blog
properties.what_visible: Bright bare-earth pit wall on N-NW margin of central pit pond; 2013 trip report describes 'about a 300 foot drop' at end of FS road
properties.access: Hwy 49 -> Brandy City Rd ~10 mi (dirt last mi). Walk pond rim clockwise.
properties.source: Round 1 ESRI Vivid 2025 verification; Lightcap Farm blog 2013; Lindgren PP 73 p.100

properties.site: Casa Loma Rd frontage cuts (I-80 Alta exit)
properties.what_visible: White Oligocene-Miocene Valley Springs rhyolitic tuff overlying Tertiary auriferous gravels and large Mio-Pliocene Mehrten andesitic boulders. Gravel visible only at base of bigger cuts - upper face is white tuff.
properties.access: Casa Loma Rd paralleling eastbound I-80 east of Alta exit 146.

properties.site: San Juan Ridge Rd cuts (Tyler Foote Crossing -> North Bloomfield)
properties.cliff_height_ft: 10-40 ridge-top cuts; 300+ ft Malakoff pit walls beyond
properties.what_visible: Intermittent ridge-top road cuts in Tertiary sedimentary/volcanic sequence; 600 ft total gravel section under ridge per Lindgren
properties.access: Hwy 49 N of Nevada City to Tyler Foote Crossing Rd, E toward North Bloomfield/Malakoff.
properties.source: Lindgren PP 73; Sierra College Sierra geology drive

properties.site: Hwy 49 cuts climbing out of N Yuba canyon to Camptonville
properties.what_visible: Rusty-red weathered Eocene surface and overlying Tertiary sedimentary/volcanic rocks; bedrock is dominant, gravel is subordinate
properties.access: Hwy 49 MM ~19-20 in Yuba/Sierra Co. Pullouts limited and narrow.
